statBlock.name: The Hungry
statBlock.description: A Shadowfell predator with grasping claws and an enormous mouth. Seeing another creature recover makes its appetite more dangerous.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits: Life Hunger. When a creature the Hungry can see regains hit points, the Hungry gains advantage on attack rolls and deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on Bite hits. Both benefits last until the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. The Hungry cannot use Claws while grappling a creature.

statBlock.name: The Lonely
statBlock.description: This sorrowsworn throws out its harpoon-like arms to pull distant creatures into reach.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Psychic Leech. At the start of the Lonely’s turn, each creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Thrives on Company. The Lonely has advantage on attack rolls when at least two other creatures are within 30 ft. Otherwise, it has disadvantage on attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Harpoon Arm attack and use Sorrowful Embrace.
Harpoon Arm. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage. It also grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). The Lonely has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.
Sorrowful Embrace. Every creature the Lonely has grappled makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage. On a success, it takes half damage. Either way, the Lonely pulls each grappled creature up to 30 ft. directly toward itself.

statBlock.name: The Lost
statBlock.description: A desperate sorrowsworn that reaches for nearby creatures. Its embrace spreads the panic it feels.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arm Spike attacks.
Arm Spike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Embrace. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the creature is frightened and takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The Lost can embrace only one creature at a time.
sections.Reactions: Tightening Embrace. When the Lost takes damage while grappling a creature, it can deal 18 (4d8) psychic damage to the grappled creature.

statBlock.name: The Wretched
statBlock.description: These small sorrowsworn hunt in packs and drain the life of creatures they latch onto.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits: Wretched Pack Tactics. The Wretched has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wretched’s allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not incapacitated. Otherwise, the Wretched has disadvantage on attack rolls.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage and attaches the Wretched to the target. While attached, the Wretched cannot attack. The target takes 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage whenever the Wretched starts its turn. The Wretched moves with the target without spending movement and can spend 5 ft. of movement on its own turn to detach. Any creature, including the target, can use its action to detach it.

statBlock.name: Titivilus
statBlock.description: Dispater’s adviser uses a silver sword, deceptive speech and magical misdirection to manipulate enemies.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Titivilus fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Titivilus has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Titivilus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. Cold or radiant damage suppresses this healing at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and does not regenerate.
Ventriloquism. Whenever Titivilus speaks, he can make his voice come from a point he chooses within 60 ft.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Titivilus casts with Charisma (spell save DC 21) and needs no material components.
At will. Alter Self, Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Confusion, Major Image, Modify Memory, Nondetection, Sending, Suggestion.
3/day each. Greater Invisibility (self only), Mislead.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Symbol (discord or sleep only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Silver Sword attack and use Frightful Word once.
Silver Sword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage with two hands. Both grips also deal 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. A creature’s hit point maximum decreases by half the necrotic damage it takes.
Frightful Word. Choose one visible creature within 10 ft. It must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom save or become frightened of Titivilus for 1 minute. On each turn while frightened this way, the creature must Dash and take the safest route away from him. If no route is available, it does not have to Dash. At the end of each of the target’s turns, it can save again to end the effect.
Teleport. Titivilus magically moves himself and the equipment he wears or carries up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Twisting Words. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma save or become charmed by Titivilus for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save if Titivilus damages it. A successful save makes it immune to his Twisting Words for 24 hours.
sections.Legendary actions:
Titivilus has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Assault (Costs 2 Actions). Make a Silver Sword attack or use Frightful Word.
Corrupting Guidance. Use Twisting Words, or choose one creature within 60 ft. that Titivilus has charmed. That creature makes a DC 21 Charisma save. On a failure, Titivilus decides how the creature acts during its next turn.
Teleport. Use the Teleport action.

statBlock.name: Tortle
statBlock.description: A turtlelike traveler whose shell protects it in a fight and lets it shelter in place.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with two hands.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
Shell Defense. The tortle withdraws into its shell and gains +4 AC and advantage on Strength and Constitution saves until it emerges. While withdrawn, it is prone, its speed is 0 and cannot increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, and it cannot take reactions or take any action except a bonus action to emerge.
